item.title: Minimalist Design Principles
item.description: The iA4 theme embodies the principles of minimalist design, focusing on content and readability above all else. This philosophy translates beautifully to the Hugo static site generator. Less is More Minimalist design isn’t about having less content—it’s about removing unnecessary elements that distract from your message. Every element on the page should serve a purpose.
